# Pull Request

## Summary

Describe the change and why it is needed.

## Type of Change

- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Configuration / examples
- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Research script update
- [ ] Evaluation utility
- [ ] Other

## Checklist

- [ ] I did not commit private datasets or credentials.
- [ ] I did not commit generated outputs or cache files.
- [ ] I did not modify model checkpoints unless necessary.
- [ ] I updated documentation if behavior changed.
- [ ] I ran `python examples/quick_smoke_check.py`.
- [ ] I ran `python tools/validate_config.py --config configs/example_dataset.yaml`.
- [ ] I described reproducibility limitations if relevant.

## Notes

Add dataset assumptions, checkpoint requirements, local path changes, or review notes here.
